integrity: All proof statements concern exact rank-one-kernel correlation matrices and Euclidean metric projection in fixed-diagonal affine space. Standalone arithmetic checker is supplementary. No independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Provides an exact one-parameter smooth-boundary lower-bound family and sharp linear growth order; not the exact unrestricted finite-dimensional Lipschitz constant or asymptotic leading coefficient.
title: Linear-in-order entrywise instability of nearest correlation projection from a smooth elliptope face
